headline: Fronts Flare as Casualties Surge Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the bloodletting has shifted markedly. Callums Cape still churns out nearly 900 Colonial and 820 Warden casualties each hour, though both streams show cooling from their earlier peak, with only two fresh base changes in the past two hours. Linn Mercy has accelerated to roughly 380 Colonial and 475 Warden losses per hour, and four bases flipped in the last two hours, keeping the sector volatile. Mooring County remains the deadliest theatre, posting about 990 Colonial and 910 Warden dead per hour, both rates accelerating, and five bases changed hands in the last two hours. Marban Hollow has erupted, jumping from negligible losses to over 630 Colonial and 460 Warden casualties per hour, with enlistments surging to 89 per hour, though no base changes occurred in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse continues heavy but slightly reduced attrition at 525 Colonial and 417 Warden per hour, with seven base events in the last two hours. Nevish Line, previously cited as accelerating, has gone quiet in the last six hours, recording only 21 Colonial and 3 Warden casualties per hour and no recent base turnover. Elsewhere, Callahans Passage and Stlican Shelf show modest 24-hour activity but no fresh moves, while most other regions remain static.
